table.name: TLGNC_MAT_PLANT
table.description: Additional Material data depending on Material+Plant which is not maintained in SAP (tlgns_sap_material_plant) but directly in Logon. See also tlgnc_mat_shippingpoint for Material+Shippingpoint(+Plant) dependent data.

column.name: SAP_MATERIAL_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_material. Material (Product) of this extended Logon Material-Plant data. Note, this is NOT the SAP Material Number, but the technical ID of that material in Logon DB. (SAP_MATERIAL_ID, PLANT_CD) is an alternative identifier.

column.name: PLANT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant_bs. (Production) plant for this extended Logon Material-Plant data. The system does not forbid to store Product+supply plant combination in this table (similar to what SAP does); if it makes sense or not is determined by the use case in the end.

column.name: PRIO_OVER_SAP_MAT_NORM_FLAG
column.description: 1 = data maintained in this table has priority over data in tlgns_sap_mat_plant_norm table. 0 (standard behavior) = If SAP mat norm has logo-data defined, these win over logo_x and logo_x_line1/2/3 fields. If nothing defined: fallback to tlgnc_mat_plant.

column.name: BULK_DENSITY_KGPM3
column.description: Bulk density ('Schuettdichte') of the material produced at plant_cd in kg per cubic meter. The real value is measured periodically and published in quality assurance sheets. The value here is used by Logon to determine the max load amount in rail wagons: For certain materials in certain wagon types the limiting factor is not the max_net_load in tons, but the maximal loading volume. Examples: Normo 4 from Untervaz 1200, Normo 5R from Untervaz 1080, Normo 4 from Siggenthal 1180.

column.name: VARIABLE_PROD_COST_MAT
column.description: Current variable production cost of material (per 1 UOM). These are costs caused when producing the material, i.e. the lookup from the order/order_item is done by production plant. The UOM is implicitly the same as for the material received from SAP.

column.name: FUTURE_VARIABLE_PROD_COST_MAT
column.description: Future variable production cost of material (per 1 UOM).

column.name: FUTURE_VALID_FROM_DAT
column.description: Validity start date of future_variable_prod_cost_mat. Current costs are valid until before future_valid_from_dat. Moving 'future' into 'current' and updating the future_valid_from_dat is a manual task, done once per year. Logon compares delivery date of order with this date and decides which cost is to be used.

column.name: CURRENCY_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_currency_bs. Currency for this Material+Plant. This does not just define the currency of (future-)variable_prod_cost_mat, but also the material valuation/prices in tlgns_sap_material_plant, e.g. val_standard_price/val_moving_avg_price. Exchange rates in tlgnc_currency_exch_rate must be respected when adding costs of various sources in one order_item.

column.name: CPD_NUMBER
column.description: CPD number. Example: CPD-C0263

column.name: CHROMAT_REDUCTION_MONTHS
column.description: No longer used! Value used on delivery note is currently taken directly from SAP shipto, see tlgns_sap_bp.CHROMAT_REDUCTION_MONTHS. Number of months, used for example in Delivery Note PDF in the text about chromat reduction (Bei sachgerechter, trockener Lagerung mind. x Monate ab Verladedatum chromatarm gemaess ChemRRV Anhang 2.16 und EU-Richtlinie 2003/53/EG).

column.name: BRAND_SALES_NAME
column.description: For NGE the material description contains also information about production level (ex: 5_Normo4). In delivery note therefore it cannot be used directly, material_description will only be shown if this field is not set. If brand_sales_name is set (ex.: Normo 4), it will be shown on delivery note.

column.name: LOGO_1
column.description: Delivery Note PDF: If not null, reference image in TLGNC_IMAGE.IMAGE_NAME (referenced image without language code) will be displayed at the place of logo 1 by default (in case image with lang_cd extension where the lang_cd is the lang_cd of the shipto sap bp (such as logo_en, logo_fr, logo_it) is present in TLGNC_IMAGE, that image will be shown, not the image defined by this column).
